verdict.rationale: Each Conductor workspace has its own terminal and running environment, with port forwarding for running apps. Agents can also test repositories and run builds. Together this implies the agent can work alongside a live app it runs, but nothing documents actually debugging a running web application from the assistant. Missing for 10: any debugger attach or breakpoint support, browser or DevTools inspection of the live app, runtime log or state inspection by the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
